items.title: DexCom (DXCM) Could Be 32% Undervalued Following Health Canada G7 Pregnancy Clearance
items.summary: DexCom (DXCM) is back in focus after Health Canada cleared its G7 sensor for use with the myLoop system powered by CamAPS FX during pregnancy, creating a tightly defined new clinical use case. Recent trading tells a mixed story. The share price is up 20.75% year to date, yet the 90-day share price return is down 10.48% and the 30-day move is down 5.54%. items.title: How Pregnancy Device Approval At DexCom (DXCM) Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: Health Canada has approved use of the Dexcom G7 continuous glucose monitoring system within the myLoop automated insulin delivery setup for pregnancy, supported by AiDAPT trial data showing improved time in pregnancy specific glucose targets without added hypoglycemia risk. This approval gives DexCom another sensor option within the myLoop ecosystem in Canada.
